description: Context window fill of the Claude Code session in the status bar, plus the 5-hour and weekly account limits. Reads local files only.
config.language: Language of the status bar item and its tooltip. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language.
config.windows: Context window per model, e.g. { "claude-haiku-5-5": 200000 }. Takes precedence over autoCompactWindow in ~/.claude/settings.json.
config.defaultWindow: Window for a model without autoCompactWindow and without an entry in windows.
config.warningPercent: From what percentage (context or a limit) the item turns yellow.
config.errorPercent: From what percentage (context or a limit) the item turns red.
config.showLimits: Show the account limits (5 h, 7 days) from ~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/heartbeat.json. Needs claude-hud; refreshed only while a Claude Code CLI session runs.
config.limitsStaleMinutes: After how many minutes without a refresh from the CLI the limits get a question mark.
config.preferVsCodeSession: Among the newest sessions of the folder, prefer the one from the VS Code panel over the CLI.
